context: StoryBot is an AI-powered workflow bot that guides teams through a 7-behavior progressive refinement process (Shape → Prioritization → Discovery → Exploration → Scenarios → Tests → Code)
The system follows a consistent 5-action workflow within each behavior: clarify → strategy → build → validate → render
Users interact through multiple modes: CLI commands (Human), REPL interactive sessions (User), MCP tools via AI assistants (AI Chat), and headless execution (Human/CLI)

The story-graph.json contains explicit user stories with 'users' fields identifying: Human, CLI, REPL, AI Chat, MCP Server Generator, Generator, Bot Developer, Bot Behavior, Bot, User, AI Agent, Automation, System, LangGraph, BotLangActionNode, BotLangFlow, BotLangFlowRunner, TTYDetector
The system architecture shows layered integration: Entry Points (MCP/CLI/REPL/Headless) → Bot (StoryBotMCPServer/StoryBotCLI) → Router → Behavior → Action → Domain Concepts
Workflow supports pause/resume through Checkpoint (SqliteSaver) and BotLangFlowRunner.resume_from() with interactive mode (BotLangActionNode) requiring human confirmation via --continue flag
Error recovery handles AI hangs and stuck scenarios with up to 3 recovery attempts (ErrorRecovery)
Headless execution mode (HeadlessSession) supports direct instructions, single operations, complete actions, and complete behaviors with blocking detection and monitoring
State management is handled through multiple layers: checkpoint/resume (BotLangFlowRunner with SqliteSaver), action state (ActionStateManager), workflow state (BotLangState), and behavior state
Format synchronization maintains consistency between JSON (story-graph.json), markdown (CRC text), and diagrams (Draw.io) through Synchronizers (StoryIOSynchronizer, DomainModelSynchronizer)
Automated infrastructure generation creates MCP servers, CLI code, REPL commands, Cursor command files, and help documentation through generators (MCP Server Generator, Generator)
Navigation supports CLI commands, REPL dot notation (e.g., 'shape.clarify'), scope management, and status displays showing bot hierarchy with progress indicators
